# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_FLAT_TO_STEEP_TRANSITION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A shift from a flat EMA ribbon to a steep bullish alignment after consolidation signals an acceleration of upward momentum. The flat ribbon indicates equilibrium; a simultaneous steepening of all four short‑term EMAs shows renewed buying pressure that can be captured with a close‑above‑55‑EMA entry.

## Mechanism

Define ribbon flat as all four EMAs (8,21,34,55) having absolute slope <0.05% for at least three consecutive 5‑min bars. Entry occurs when, on the same bar, all four EMAs slope >0.15% upward and price closes above the 55‑EMA. Go long at the close of that bar. Exit: chart‑stop at the lowest low of the flat‑ribbon region (most recent swing low), target 2R, then trail the remainder with a chandelier exit (ATR×3). Regime hint: effective in choppy, low‑VIX (<18) conditions and during the midday window (11:00‑13:30) when consolidation resolves; avoid strongly trending days where the ribbon is already steep.
